perfil: Rocking a swimsuit chosen by everyone, Willow is finally learning how to kick back and enjoy a work-free vacation.

habilidades.b: Tap the Main Skill button to switch between weapon modes: Bubble Machine and Megaphone. Both modes continuously fire bubbles to deal DMG. In Bubble Machine mode, inflicts ⟨Bubble Mark⟩.

tpl.s: Tap the Main Skill button to switch between weapon modes. ⟦0⟧ Strike 1 to 3: Deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG multiple times. Strike 4: Deals ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG In this mode, Auto Attacks inflict ⟨Bubble Mark⟩ when dealing DMG. ⟦3⟧ Strike 1 to 3: Deals ⟦4⟧ of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG multiple times. Strike 4: Deals ⟦5⟧ of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG.

habilidades.b: When tapping the Main Skill button, different effects occur based on the current ⟨Decibels⟩. ⟦Current Decibels below 100:⟧ Switches back and forth between Bubble Machine and Megaphone modes. ⟦Current Decibels at 100:⟧ Consumes all Decibels at once and launches a Bubble Frog: every bounce creates an impact dealing AoE Aqua Skill DMG and inflicting ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩. When Bubble Frog deals DMG, increases the squad's ATK.

tpl.s: When tapping the Main Skill button, different effects occur based on the current ⟨Decibels⟩. ⟦0⟧ Switches back and forth between Bubble Machine and Megaphone modes. ⟦1⟧ Consumes all Decibels at once and launches a Bubble Frog: every bounce creates an impact dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG and inflicting ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩, bouncing once every 3s. When Bubble Frog deals DMG, increases the squad's ATK by ⟦3⟧ for 6s, stacking up to 5 times.

Willow then follows the Main Trekker, slowly firing bubbles that continuously deal Aqua Skill DMG for 17s. All of the above DMG can inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩. While Willow is on the field, she provides different statuses to the squad based on the current ⟨Decibels⟩: Gentle Warning: Decibels ≤40, increases Aqua DMG Safety Alert: 40< Decibels ≤100, additionally increases ATK

tpl.s: Willow dives into the water, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG in a large area and generating a 7m-radius Bubble Bath that deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG every 3s. Willow then follows the Main Trekker, slowly firing bubbles, continuously dealing ⟦2⟧ as Aqua Skill DMG for 17s. All of the above DMG can inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩. While Willow is on the field, she provides different statuses to the squad based on the current ⟨Decibels⟩: Gentle Warning: Decibels ≤40, increases Aqua DMG by ⟦3⟧ Safety Alert: 40< Decibels ≤100, additionally increases ATK by ⟦4⟧.

builds.d: A build centered on enlarging the Bubble Frog to deal massive AoE damage.
A build centered on rapid bounces from the Bubble Frog to unleash Echoing Soundwave.

l.b: In Bubble Machine mode, targets with ⟨Bubble Mark⟩ generate absorbable bubbles. After absorbing them, Bubble Frog grows in size, and the Skill DMG it deals increases.
l.s: In Bubble Machine mode, targets with ⟨Bubble Mark⟩ periodically generate absorbable bubbles. Each bubble absorbed by Bubble Frog enlarges it by ⟦0⟧, while also increasing the Skill DMG dealt by Bubble Frog by ⟦1⟧. It can grow up to ⟦2⟧ in size.

l.b: In Bubble Machine mode, Bubble Frog deals Aqua Skill DMG to nearby targets over time while increasing their Aqua DMG Taken and inflicting ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.
l.s: In Bubble Machine mode, Bubble Frog deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG every second to nearby targets, while increasing their Aqua DMG Taken by ⟦1⟧ for 8s, stacking up to 4 times. Can inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.

l.b: In Bubble Machine mode, bubbles deal additional AoE Aqua Skill DMG. Can inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩. Increases the Aqua DMG dealt by all Aqua Trekkers against targets with ⟨Bubble Mark⟩.
l.s: In Bubble Machine mode, bubbles deal an additional ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG. Can inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩. Increases Aqua DMG dealt by all Aqua Trekkers against targets with the ⟨Bubble Mark⟩ by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When Willow and Bubble Frog deal DMG to targets with ⟨Bubble Mark⟩, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
l.s: When Willow and Bubble Frog deal DMG to targets with ⟨Bubble Mark⟩, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: When a squadmate triggers ⟨Aqua Mark⟩ or inflicts ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩ on targets with ⟨Bubble Mark⟩,  increases all Aqua Trekkers' Skill DMG in the squad.
l.s: When a squadmate triggers ⟨Aqua Mark⟩ or inflicts ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩ on targets with ⟨Bubble Mark⟩,  increases all Aqua Trekkers' Skill DMG in the squad by ⟦0⟧ for 6s, stacking up to 6 times.

l.b: In Megaphone mode, increases Bubble Frog's bounce frequency and Skill DMG. Each bounce grants additional Decibels.
l.s: In Megaphone mode, increases Bubble Frog's bounce frequency by ⟦0⟧ and Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧. Each bounce grants 5 additional Decibels.

l.b: In Megaphone mode, Bubble Frog unleashes ⟨Echoing Soundwave⟩ when bouncing, which can echo multiple times, dealing Aqua Skill DMG and increasing the target's DMG Taken of all Elements. This DMG can inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩. The Attack Range of ⟨Echoing Soundwave⟩ increases based on the current Decibels.
l.s: In Megaphone mode, each bounce of Bubble Frog unleashes ⟨Echoing Soundwave⟩ that echo ⟦0⟧ times, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG and increasing the target's DMG Taken of all Elements by ⟦2⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 8 times. This DMG can inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩. For every ⟦3⟧ current Decibels, increases the Attack Range of ⟨Echoing Soundwave⟩ by ⟦4⟧.

l.b: After bouncing a certain number of times, Bubble Frog deals Aqua Skill DMG in a large area. Can inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩, while increasing the target's DMG Taken of all Elements.
l.s: Every 2 bounces, Bubble Frog deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG in a large area. Can inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩, while increasing the target's DMG Taken of all Elements by ⟦1⟧ for 5s.

l.b: When ⟨Echoing Soundwave⟩ deal DMG, increases own and non-Aqua Squadmates' ATK.
l.s: When ⟨Echoing Soundwave⟩ deal DMG, increases own and non-Aqua Squadmates' ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 8 times.

l.b: Each time Bubble Frog bounces, increases the squad's Skill DMG. Additionally, increases non-Aqua Squadmates' Skill DMG.
l.s: Each time Bubble Frog bounces, increases the squad's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. Additionally, increases non-Aqua Squadmates' Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧. This effect lasts 2.5s, stacking up to 8 times.

l.b: Increases Bubble Frog duration, and while it is on the field, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: Increases Bubble Frog duration by 3s, and while it is on the field, increases the squad's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Can dodge one more time. After Willow dodges, increases own ATK.
l.s: Increases Dodge count by 1. After Willow dodges, increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 8s.

l.b: When Bubble Frog deals DMG, Willow gains a shield.
l.s: When Bubble Frog deals DMG, Willow gains a shield equal to ⟦0⟧ of Base ATK for 6s. This effect can only be triggered once every 10s.

l.b: Increases Ultimate DMG. After casting the Ultimate, generates additional Decibels for a period of time.
l.s: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Beach Warning (Ultimate) by ⟦0⟧. After casting the Ultimate, Willow gains 3 additional Decibels every 1.5s, up to a total of 30 Decibels.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: When casting Beach Warning (Ultimate), increases the squad's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 25s.

l.b: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
l.s: When Beach Warning deals DMG, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 20s, stacking up to 5 times.

builds.d: A build that fires piercing water jets to strike enemies while inflicting powerful debuffs on targets.
A build rapidly unleashes piercing soundwaves while granting stats buffs to the squad.

l.b: ⟨Gentle Warning⟩ gains additional stat bonuses from ⟨Safety Alert⟩. For every ⟦10⟧ shots fired by Willow while under Gentle Warning, she fires a straight-line water column attack that deals Aqua Skill DMG and increases Decibels, while applying ⟨Smiling Sanction⟩ and ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.
l.s: ⟨Gentle Warning⟩ gains additional stat bonuses from ⟨Safety Alert⟩. For every ⟦0⟧ shots fired by Willow while under Gentle Warning, she fires a straight-line water column attack that deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG and increases Decibels by ⟦2⟧, inflicting ⟨Smiling Sanction⟩ and ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.

l.b: When Decibels ≥40, consumes Decibels to fire a rotating water jet, dealing AoE Aqua Skill DMG and inflicting ⟨Smiling Sanction⟩ and ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.
l.s: When Decibels ≥⟦0⟧, immediately consumes ⟦1⟧ Decibels to launch a rotating water jet attack, dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG, inflicting ⟨Smiling Sanction⟩ and ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.

l.b: When a target with ⟨Smiling Sanction⟩ has ⟨Aqua Mark⟩ triggered, this target is immediately inflicted with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩ again and receives additional Aqua Mark DMG. The Mark DMG received this time is increased based on the stacks of ⟨Smiling Sanction⟩.
l.s: When a target with ⟨Smiling Sanction⟩ has ⟨Aqua Mark⟩ triggered, this target is immediately inflicted with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩ again and receives an additional ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Aqua Mark DMG. For each stack of ⟨Smiling Sanction⟩ this target has, increases the Mark DMG received this time by ⟦1⟧. This effect can only be triggered once every 1.5s.

l.b: When entering with the Support Skill, the DMG from diving into the water also inflicts 1 stack of ⟨Smiling Sanction⟩. Increases the max stack limit of ⟨Smiling Sanction⟩, and additionally increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
l.s: When entering with Frolic in the Sea (Support Skill), the DMG from diving into the water also inflicts 1 stack of ⟨Smiling Sanction⟩. The max stack limit of ⟨Smiling Sanction⟩ is increased to ⟦0⟧ stacks, and each stack additionally increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: While ⟨Gentle Warning⟩ is active, additionally increases the squad's Aqua DMG, and the Main Trekker generates extra Decibels when dealing DMG.
l.s: While ⟨Gentle Warning⟩ is active, increases the squad's Aqua DMG by an additional ⟦0⟧; the Main Trekker generates 8 extra Decibels when dealing DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

l.b: Increases initial Decibels upon entering the field. At full Decibels, increases the squad's Crit Rate, while continuously consuming Decibels to rapidly fire bubbles.
l.s: Initial Decibel upon entering the field equals ⟦0⟧. At ⟦1⟧ Decibels, increases the squad's Crit Rate by ⟦2⟧ for 14s, while consuming Decibels over time to rapidly fire bubbles until Decibels drop to ⟦3⟧.

l.b: Increases Decibels gained from shots. While ⟨Safety Alert⟩ is active, bubbles turn into sonic waves, increasing DMG Multiplier and the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
l.s: Increases Decibels gained per shot from ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧. While ⟨Safety Alert⟩ is active, bubbles turn into piercing sonic waves, increasing DMG Multiplier by ⟦2⟧, and increasing the target's Aqua DMG Taken by ⟦3⟧ for 8s, stacking up to 16 times.

l.b: For every certain number of shots fired by Willow, a blue bubble is generated near targets inside Bubble Bath, dealing AoE Aqua Skill DMG, while increasing the squad's Crit Rate. When a blue bubble is generated, there is a chance it turns into a red bubble, additionally increasing Main Trekker's ATK.
l.s: For every 8 shots fired by Willow, a blue bubble is generated near targets inside Bubble Bath, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG, while increasing the squad's Crit Rate by ⟦1⟧ for 9s. When a blue bubble is generated, there is a 50% chance it turns into a red bubble, additionally increasing Main Trekker's ATK by ⟦2⟧ for 9s.

l.b: Bubble Bath expands over time. When the Main Trekker is inside Bubble Bath, increases her Aqua DMG.
l.s: Bubble Bath expands by 5% every second, up to 30%. When the Main Trekker is inside Bubble Bath, increases her Aqua DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Consuming Decibels increases the squad's Crit DMG.
l.s: Each time Decibels are consumed, increases the squad's Crit DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 9s, stacking up to 16 times.

l.b: Each Aqua Trekker in the squad increases the squad's DEF PEN.
l.s: Each Aqua Trekker in the squad increases the squad's DEF PEN by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: After staying in Bubble Bath for a period of time, the Main Trekker gains a shield.
l.s: The Main Trekker inside Bubble Bath gains a shield equal to ⟦0⟧ of Willow's Base ATK every 5s for 4s.

l.b: When Willow is on the battlefield, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: When Willow is on the battlefield, increases the squad's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Ultimate DMG. After casting the Ultimate, generates additional Decibels for a period of time.
l.s: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Beach Warning (Ultimate) by ⟦0⟧. After casting the Ultimate, Willow gains 3 additional Decibels every 1.5s, up to a total of 30 Decibels.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: When casting Beach Warning (Ultimate), increases the squad's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 25s.

l.b: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
l.s: When Beach Warning deals DMG, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 20s, stacking up to 5 times.
